name: Swirling clouds
description: A cyclone seen head-on: a slab of volumetric cloud sheared into spiral arms by differential rotation, with a clear eye and self-shadowed billows. Slower and grander than `clouds` - for builds, breakdowns and anything that wants scale.

swirl.description: Strength of the 1/r shear that winds the bands into arms.

eye.description: Radius of the hole punched through the middle of the disc.

shade.description: How hard the light-march taps darken the far side of a billow.
